items.source: Callback interface that can be implemented by beans wishing to customize the DriverConfigLoaderBuilderCustomizer to fine-tune its auto-configuration before it creates a DriverConfigLoader.
items.translation: 可被希望自定义DriverConfigLoaderBuilderCustomizer的 Bean 实现的回调接口，以便在创建DriverConfigLoader之前微调其自动配置。
Cassandra 的自动配置。

items.source: Callback interface that can be implemented by beans wishing to customize the CqlSessionBuilder to fine-tune its auto-configuration before it creates a CqlSession.
items.translation: 可被希望自定义 CqlSessionBuilder 以在创建 CqlSession 之前微调其自动配置的 Bean 实现的回调接口。
Cassandra 健康检查的自动配置。

items.source: Details required to establish a connection to a Cassandra service.
items.translation: 建立与 Cassandra 服务连接所需的详细信息。

items.source: Name of the algorithm used to compress protocol frames.
items.translation: 用于压缩协议帧的算法名称。
